sites.evidence_type: published tag insertion in the same loop or domain
sites.functional_impact_measured: Receptor pharmacology (ligand binding / signalling) shown to be comparable to untagged CTR constructs (L2); surface expression confirmed by anti-HA immunostaining (L4); construct described as previously validated (L3).
sites.rationale: All four ledger lines describe N-terminal epitope tags (HA or Flag) on full-length, membrane-anchored human CTR. The signal peptide spans residues 1–24 (authoritative landmark); the mature N-terminus begins at residue 25 (A). Inserting the tag after residue 24 (P) places it immediately before the first mature extracellular residue, well upstream of TM1 (residue 147, ≥122 residues away), ensuring the tag is extracellular and not cleaved with the signal peptide. Python verification confirms residue_before = P (position 24) and residue_after = A (position 25). L2 is chosen as the primary clip because it explicitly documents preserved pharmacology, providing the highest validation level. Full-length human CTR (CALCR) bearing an N-terminal HA epitope tag expressed in mammalian cells; the tag is placed after the signal-peptide cleavage site (residue 24) so it is displayed on the extracellular face of the mature receptor. L2 explicitly reports comparable pharmacology to untagged receptor; L3 and L4 confirm surface expression by immunostaining; L1 corroborates with an N-terminal Flag tag on the same full-length membrane-anchored construct.

sources.claim: Human CLR and CTR with N-terminal hemagglutinin (HA) epitope tags were used in these experiments.

literature_notes: All four ledger lines (L1–L4) pin the same junction: an N-terminal epitope tag on full-length membrane-anchored human CTR, placed after signal-peptide cleavage (after residue 24). No ledger line supports any internal extracellular loop insertion for CALCR. L1 additionally describes a C-terminal 8×His tag; the C-terminus (residues 395–474) is intracellular per the authoritative topology landmarks, so that tag is recorded in other_positions. No ledger evidence supports any insertion in ECL1 (205–217), ECL2 (284–294), or ECL3 (360–367).

literature_other_positions.note: L1 reports a C-terminal 8×His tag on full-length CTR; residue 474 (A) lies within the intracellular C-terminal tail (topology landmarks: intracellular 395–474), so this tag faces the cytoplasm, not the extracellular surface.
